notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional publication and region-release boundary. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies that a region used by a regional object update association remains in use until the associated attribute publication is withdrawn, after which region deletion and handle invalidation succeed synchronously, without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional publication, object registration, unpublication, region deletion, and region-handle lookup services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional publication and region lifecycle declarations
